endpoints.description:
Every ER visit, newest first, by the day of arrival: triage, stage, how the patient left (MSDS 20: admitted to
which ward and when; discharged with the condition and follow-up; referred where and why; LAMA; on request with the
signed statement; left without being seen; died; brought dead).

**Required permission:** `er.visit.view`

**Required permission:** `er.visit.view`

items.title: ErVisitOut

er_number.title: Er Number
er_number.description: The ER register number, e.g. ER-2026-000042

admission_id.title: Admission Id
admission_id.description: Code Red, or the admission requested from the ER

triage_target_minutes.title: Triage Target Minutes
triage_target_minutes.description: The level's target time from triage to the doctor

seen_at.title: Seen At
seen_at.description: First seen by a doctor (called in, or taken for treatment)

is_medico_legal.title: Is Medico Legal
is_medico_legal.description: The medico-legal checklist; null: not decided yet

mlc_id.title: Mlc Id
mlc_id.description: The medico-legal case opened for this visit

admission_decided_at.title: Admission Decided At
admission_decided_at.description: When the visit first waited for an admission

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: What is overdue by the hospital's targets (settings er_*), and a medico-legal checklist still to answer
